ogent agent guide (contract 1)
Load ogent normally, then inspect (ogent-agent-capabilities 'json).
This reads the live registry; an empty tools array means no tools are installed.
(ogent-tools-install-defaults) explicitly installs built-in specs if wanted.
Use canonical hyphen names or registered underscore aliases; typos get hints, never execution.
Arguments follow registry order; named calls reject unknown/duplicate keys before approval.
Native boolean false is nil or :json-false; zero and nested objects are preserved.
MCP calls use :json-false for explicit false; optional nil means omit the argument.
Tool results remain text. JSON discovery and doctor reports use contract_version 1.
Read: (ogent-tool--read-file "/path/file" 1 200); follow the exact next offset in its footer.
Search: (ogent-tool--glob "**/*.el" "/path/project") includes every depth.
Grep: (ogent-tool--grep "-needle" "/path/project"); no matches is success, invalid regex is an error.
Edit: old_string must be nonempty and unique; set replace_all to t only for intentional repeated replacement.
Read-only tools need no confirmation by default. Writes and shell execution require approval.
Direct ogent-tool-- functions are low-level APIs; use registered execution wrappers for approval enforcement.
Shell: use a positive timeout in seconds and an existing working_directory.
Shell stdout/stderr may be truncated; the final exit code is preserved.
Local health: (ogent-agent-triage 'json), no provider requests or MCP handshakes.
Batch health: (ogent-doctor-batch nil 'json), exit 0=ok/info, 1=warning, 2=error.
Check readiness offline: make test; make test-isolation; make offline-test with OGENT_ELPA_DIR.
